programs.title: Lorie
programs.desc: Geeta Malhotra (Shabana Azmi) is depressed after she has a miscarriage and the doctor declares that she will not be able to conceive again. One day, she comes across a small boy left behind inadvertently in the city bus by his family. She takes him home and starts treating him like her own son. She becomes obsessed with the child. Unfortunately for Geeta, the boy's family turns up to take him back and Geeta has to face trial for his abduction.

programs.title: Khakee
programs.desc: DCP Anant and his team are assigned to escort an alleged terrorist from Chandangarh to Mumbai. His seemingly simple mission turns into a deadly encounter of survival when a rogue ex-cop turned criminal hinders his way.
